description: Per-event latency from packet ingest to policy enforcement, composed from measured stage latencies. The deterministic fast path (detection + rule decision + physics verify) is reported separately from the LLM advisory path and the live SDN flow-install step.
pipeline: packet -> detection -> decision -> physics verify -> ONOS intent -> OVS flow-install

detection_infer.note: windowed/streaming detection is ~0.02 ms/pkt (~50k pkt/s); the 25 ms single-call figure is isolated sklearn predict overhead, not the critical-path cost
detection_infer.source: measured, RandomForest 300 trees on behavioural features

physics_verify_ms.note: sub-ms at 278 nodes; tens of ms at 8500

llm_advisory_path.note: LLM policy synthesis is advisory and OFF the enforcement critical path; the deterministic rule path (0.015 ms) enforces while the LLM proposes.

sdn_flow_install.status: requires the live ONOS + OVS cluster, which is not currently stood up on this host
sdn_flow_install.note: Controller mastership failover was measured at p50 2.48 s over 7 trials (controller_failover_summary.json); steady-state flow-install on a healthy cluster is far faster, but a precise packet-to-flow-table number needs the live 3-node cluster running.

takeaway: The deterministic enforcement fast path (detection + rule decision + physics verify) is sub-millisecond amortized (~0.34 ms), three to four orders of magnitude faster than the ~1.9 s LLM advisory path. GridCAD enforces on the fast path and uses the LLM only to propose, so LLM latency is not on the safety-critical enforcement path.
